# freewheel

> freewheel is open-source (MIT) mobile live streaming: it bonds several cellular links into one stream. Written from scratch in Rust, wire-compatible with BELABOX's SRTLA, with its own transport on top. Built by VOILA DEVELOPMENT (https://voila.dev).

## Benchmark
- On recorded LTE uplinks from a moving car (`trace-drive`, 3 links), freewheel's transport loses about 530 frames out of ~2,700, against about 1,750 for upstream SRTLA and 1,950 for irlserver/srtla_send. Median of 3 CI runs on an ARM64 runner.
- Method and raw results: https://github.com/voila-voila-dev/freewheel/blob/main/bench/README.md

## Status
- Runs in emulation and CI only. No hardware demo yet.
